description: Upload a supported image, video, PDF, font or text asset. Acceptance is not readiness: wait for processed before sharing. Project-user scoped upload keys restrict uploads to their identity. API uploads require a paid plan.

data.description: At most five scalar fields; UTF-8/encoded size limits apply

file_path.description: Local file path; provide exactly one file source

file_url.description: HTTP(S) file downloaded on the MCP machine, then uploaded

quality.description: Video quality only; availability depends on the plan

name: upload_asset
